name: release-notes-generation
description: Draft user-facing RELEASE_NOTES.md from git history since the last tag, leaving out internal-only changes and putting security fixes first.
spec: Skill: release-notes-generation. Workflow: (1) Claude runs `git tag` and `git log --oneline <last-tag>..HEAD`, saves the log lines to a file, and reads CHANGES/README/diffs for context. (2) It runs `python3 scripts/classify_commits.py commits.txt` to bucket each commit by conventional-commit prefix or leading keywords. Output is JSON with the keys security, features, improvements, fixes, docs, internal and other. Each item has hash, scope and message. Input order is kept, and no-prefix subjects such as "Add ...", "Fix ...", "Speed up ..." or "Update CI image" are handled. (3) Claude uses judgment for the prose. It rewrites messages in plain user language and decides the 'other' bucket and the docs bucket. It drops internal changes (refactor, chore, ci, test, deps, renames) unless users would notice them, for example a dependency upgrade that changes behaviour. It puts a Security section first, notes any user action needed (e.g. a new length limit), and writes RELEASE_NOTES.md with sections New features, Improvements, Bug fixes and optionally Documentation. Accepted sessions grouped by features and fixes. The user's edit note said: leave out dependency/CI/test changes unless users notice them, and put security fixes first. If commits only touch the changelog and not code, say so in the reply. Replies should be one line. The helper does not run git, because scripts may not spawn subprocesses. It only reads the file passed as an argument, or stdin when the argument is '-'. A missing file exits with code 2. The helper's JSON output is computed from the logged commit lists; it is not itself present in the logs.

tests.name: weather-cli commits
tests.rationale: Input is the real commit list from the accepted session; expected buckets are the helper's classification (internal refactor/chore excluded, docs separated), not present verbatim in logs.

input_files.content:
f4926fe refactor: split api client into its own module
00161c6 feat: show a 3-day forecast with --days
dc79f36 docs: explain the config file location
4f18067 chore: bump pytest to 8.3
29a15d5 fix: crash when the city name contains spaces
1b50316 feat: add --units flag to switch between metric and imperial
